page_title: 21 Free Agentic AI Design Patterns for Developers (2026)

sources.entry: 11. Learn Agentic Patterns - Free interactive curriculum covering 21 agentic AI design patterns with code examples, architecture diagrams, and interactive decision-making games.

summary.name: Learn Agentic Patterns
summary.one_liner: A free, account-optional interactive curriculum of six courses teaching agentic AI design patterns to developers and product managers, with code, decision games and a simulated interview.
use_cases: learn agentic AI design patterns as a developer
prepare for an AI engineer or agent engineer interview
study agent evaluation and tracing as an evals engineer
understand agent trade-offs as a product manager
summary.what_it_does: The site offers six free courses totalling 43 lessons (about 9 hours 40 minutes): AI Engineer, Agent Engineer, AI Evals Engineer, AI Product Manager, a 21 Agentic Design Patterns reference course, and a 15 Product Manager Modules course. The 21 patterns cover topics such as prompt chaining, routing, reflection, tool use, planning, multi-agent collaboration, memory, MCP, A2A, RAG, guardrails and evaluation. The developer track includes code examples and pseudocode referencing LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI and AutoGen, and is framework agnostic. The page describes a roughly 12-minute simulated interview in which the user finds a bug in a real agent run and writes a fix that a real model runs. A daily challenge uses a broken agent to practise debugging.
notable: 21 agentic design patterns, each mapped to a software idea, with code and a broken agent to fix
Simulated interview on a real agent run with the bug left in, graded by a real model run
Separate code-free product manager track with 15 modules
Account optional to read; a free account only saves progress across devices
caveats: Progress saving requires a free account, though reading is possible without one
The developer track assumes existing software engineering experience (APIs, distributed systems, production code)
